items.name: McCrispy
items._unverified_reason: Independent sources split into two disagreeing clusters: FatSecret AU's archived listing (634 cal/26.2P/59.2C/27.6F) closely matches this draft, but macmenusau.com and other aggregators report ~470 cal/26P/46C/20F for what they also call 'McCrispy' -- possibly a different/renamed product (search results also surfaced a distinct 'Crispy Chicken Deluxe Burger' on CalorieKing). Needs a source that can positively confirm which product name is current before this can be resolved either way.
